audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 matches a 53.8% Xerath win rate over 3487 games and an all-Xerath level chart that agrees across both layers. Lissandra's longest threat is Glacial Path at 1050 with a travel time; Ice Shard is 725 and Ring of Frost 450, all inside charged Q range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike ignored what Frozen Tomb does when self-cast.
audit.why: Frozen Tomb on herself makes Lissandra untargetable and invulnerable while healing, so a Rite of the Arcane barrage fired into it is 100 mana and a 130-second cooldown spent on nothing. Anti-heal timing decides extended trades against it.
audit.corrected: breakdown.mid and spikes[1].text now say to hold R until the ice drops.

audit.whatIsWrong: Xerath's E was repeatedly called a root (whys[2], spikes[0].text, content mid); Glacial Path's cooldown was never stated; the untargetable window on Frozen Tomb was absent.
audit.why: Shocking Orb stuns, it does not root — the distinction matters because a stun also interrupts. Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1 and 12s at rank 5, which is the whole green-light system this page is built on, and it was described without a single number.
audit.corrected: Stun wording restored, Glacial Path cooldowns stated, Ring of Frost 450 / Ice Shard 725 named, Frozen Tomb untargetability recorded.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries the real numbers.
audit.corrected: Glacial Path 24s->12s, Shocking Orb 13s, Frozen Tomb 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: 20 lint findings: 18 misgender plus two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim). Packet also flagged 'Glacial Paths' / 'Glacial Path-in' as mangled ability names.

edits.before: Through levels 3-5 you win by out-ranging and punishing her engage: her only gap-close is Glacial Path (E), and if you hold your root for that dash and land it, you win the trade hard while she has no sustain to recover. notes: Level chart agrees across both layers (Xerath all seven rows) and matches the packet, so no chart edits were needed. The untargetable/heal interaction on a self-cast Frozen Tomb was genuinely absent from the page and is now in breakdown.mid and spikes[1]; the anti-heal half of that missing-interaction entry (Grievous Wounds timing) is NOT in any edit — the itemization line is a report[] entry and the sweep caps report rewrites, so I left it and am recording it here instead. Xerath's E was called a root in three places; it stuns.
